source: Standard karana cycle (confirmed against Drik Panchang: Kimstughna at Chaitra shukla padyami; Vishti→Bava→Balava; Taitila→Garaja→Vanija). Telugu only where design/handoff has it.
notes: karana number k = floor(((Moon − Sun) mod 360) / 6) + 1 (1–60 per lunar month). k = 1 → fixed[0]; k = 2–57 → movable[(k − 2) mod 7]; k = 58, 59, 60 → fixed[1], fixed[2], fixed[3].
